about: Which project commits the views-and-models cases came from (2026-10-16). test_model_lint.py and test_make_check_file.py use these to re-run the full cases from the project's git history and Blender scenes; each part skips cleanly when the project or Blender is not on the machine. The project is found through FILM_PROJECT, or the folder austerity-explainer next to the plugins folder; Blender through BLENDER, explainer-film-setup's machine-settings.env, or the PATH; the virtual screen through BLENDER_DISPLAY.
